## Featured Projects & Case Studies
- [Pandivo TV](https://www.mahaveer.live/projects/pandivo-tv): Next-Gen AI-Powered Music & Continuous AI DJ Experience for Amazon Fire TV & Android TV. Features an autonomous Continuous AI DJ powered by AWS Bedrock (Nova Lite) & Gemini 3.5 Flash, 100% on-device speech-to-text via Whistle AI (C++ JNI, ~16.9MB acoustic model) with 80Hz HPF and peak AGC, USB plug-and-play audio player, and non-blocking SQLite WAL + DynamoDB replication. Verified at 60 FPS on physical Fire OS hardware in Amazon Appstore Quality Central. Standalone release APK available.
- [Geo-Guardian](https://www.mahaveer.live/projects/geo-guardian): Real-time danger zone geofencing dashboard built with React, Leaflet Draw, Socket.io, Express, and MongoDB 2dsphere spatial calculation indexes.
- [NoteMate](https://www.mahaveer.live/projects/note-mate): Intelligent workspace with draggable canvas notes and an AI study planner powered by NVIDIA Llama API.
- [PDF Flow](https://www.mahaveer.live/projects/pdf-flow): Client-side document converter (DOCX, PPT, XLSX, images to PDF) built with Next.js 15 and pdf-lib for zero-server data privacy.
- [Sow & Grow](https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/Sow-Grow): Multimodal agricultural assistant for crop diagnostics and market intelligence using Flutter and Gemini Flash.
